verses.original: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֚אוּ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וְיָחֹ֥גּוּ לִ֖י בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar bā·’ū mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mə·rū ’el- par·‘ōh kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl šal·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·yā·ḥōg·gū lî bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: After that Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Let My people go so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: E DEPOIS foram Moisés e Arão e disseram a Faraó: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me celebre uma festa no deserto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה מִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶשְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹל֔וֹ לְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֲשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh mî Yah·weh ’ă·šer ’eš·ma‘ bə·qō·lōw lə·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lō yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḡam ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lō ’ă·šal·lê·aḥ
verses.literal: But Pharaoh replied Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go I do not know the LORD and I will not let Israel go
verses.literalPt: Mas Faraó disse: Quem é o SENHOR, cuja voz eu ouvirei, para deixar ir Israel? Não conheço o SENHOR, nem tampouco deixarei ir Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָעִבְרִ֖ים נִקְרָ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ נֵ֣לֲכָה נָּ֡א דֶּרֶךְ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֜ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְנִזְבְּחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ פֶּ֨ן־ יִפְגָּעֵ֔נוּ בַּדֶּ֖בֶר א֥וֹ בֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rîm niq·rā ‘ā·lê·nū nê·lă·ḵāh nā de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm bam·miḏ·bār wə·niz·bə·ḥāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū pen- yip̄·gā·‘ê·nū bad·de·ḇer ’ōw ḇe·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: The God of the Hebrews has met with us they answered Please let us go on a three-day . . . journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword
verses.literalPt: E eles disseram: O Deus dos hebreus nos encontrou; portanto deixa-nos agora ir caminho de três dias ao deserto, para que ofereçamos sacrifícios ao SENHOR nosso Deus, e ele não venha sobre nós com pestilência ou com espada.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָ֚מָּה מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן תַּפְרִ֥יעוּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם מִמַּֽעֲשָׂ֑יו לְכ֖וּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim lām·māh mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn tap̄·rî·‘ū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām mim·ma·‘ă·śāw lə·ḵū lə·siḇ·lō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: But the king of Egypt said to them Moses and Aaron why do you draw the people away from their work Get back to your labor
verses.literalPt: Então disse-lhes o rei do Egito: Moisés e Arão, por que fazeis cessar o povo das suas obras? Ide às vossas cargas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה הֵן־ רַבִּ֥ים עַתָּ֖ה עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁבַּתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם מִסִּבְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh hên- rab·bîm ‘at·tāh ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hiš·bat·tem ’ō·ṯām mis·siḇ·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: Pharaoh also said Look the people of the land are now numerous . . . and you would be stopping them from their labor
verses.literalPt: E disse também Faraó: Eis que o povo da terra já é muito, e vós os fazeis abandonar as suas cargas.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו פַּרְעֹ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֶת־ הַנֹּגְשִׂ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם וְאֶת־ שֹׁטְרָ֖יו לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw par·‘ōh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’eṯ- han·nō·ḡə·śîm bā·‘ām wə·’eṯ- šō·ṭə·rāw lê·mōr
verses.literal: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen . . .
verses.literalPt: Portanto deu ordem Faraó, naquele mesmo dia, aos exatores do povo, e aos seus oficiais, dizendo:

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאסִפ֞וּן לָתֵ֨ת תֶּ֧בֶן לָעָ֛ם לִלְבֹּ֥ן הַלְּבֵנִ֖ים כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם הֵ֚ם יֵֽלְכ֔וּ וְקֹשְׁשׁ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·si·p̄ūn lā·ṯêṯ te·ḇen lā·‘ām lil·bōn hal·lə·ḇê·nîm kiṯ·mō·wl šil·šōm hêm yê·lə·ḵū wə·qō·šə·šū lā·hem te·ḇen
verses.literal: You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks - They must go and gather their own straw
verses.literalPt: Daqui em diante não torneis a dar palha ao povo, para fazer tijolos, como fizestes antes: vão eles mesmos, e colham palha para si.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מַתְכֹּ֨נֶת הַלְּבֵנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים תְּמ֤וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם֙ תָּשִׂ֣ימוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־ נִרְפִּ֣ים הֵ֔ם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן הֵ֤ם צֹֽעֲקִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- maṯ·kō·neṯ hal·lə·ḇê·nîm ’ă·šer hêm ‘ō·śîm tə·mō·wl šil·šōm tā·śî·mū ‘ă·lê·hem lō ṯiḡ·rə·‘ū mim·men·nū kî- nir·pîm hêm ‘al- kên hêm ṣō·‘ă·qîm lê·mōr nê·lə·ḵāh niz·bə·ḥāh lê·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before . . . do not reduce it . . . For they are lazy that is why . . . they are crying out . . . Let us go and sacrifice to our God
verses.literalPt: E lhes imporeis a conta dos tijolos que fizeram antes; nada diminuireis dela, porque eles estão ociosos; por isso clamam, dizendo: Vamos, sacrifiquemos ao nosso Deus.

verses.original: תִּכְבַּ֧ד הָעֲבֹדָ֛ה עַל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְיַעֲשׂוּ־ בָ֑הּ וְאַל־ יִשְׁע֖וּ בְּדִבְרֵי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: tiḵ·baḏ hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ‘al- hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·ya·‘ă·śū- ḇāh wə·’al- yiš·‘ū bə·ḏiḇ·rê- šā·qer
verses.literal: Make the work harder . . . on the men so they will be occupied . . . and pay no attention to these lies . . .
verses.literalPt: Agrave-se o serviço sobre estes homens, para que se ocupem nele e não confiem em palavras mentirosas.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ נֹגְשֵׂ֤י הָעָם֙ וְשֹׁ֣טְרָ֔יו וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֵינֶ֛נִּי נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū nō·ḡə·śê hā·‘ām wə·šō·ṭə·rāw way·yō·mə·rū ’el- hā·‘ām lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar par·‘ōh ’ê·nen·nî nō·ṯên lā·ḵem te·ḇen
verses.literal: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them This is what . . . Pharaoh says I am no longer giving you straw
verses.literalPt: Então saíram os exatores do povo, e seus oficiais, e falaram ao povo, dizendo: Assim diz Faraó: Eu não vos darei palha;

verses.original: אַתֶּ֗ם לְכ֨וּ קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ תֶּ֔בֶן מֵאֲשֶׁ֖ר תִּמְצָ֑אוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נִגְרָ֛ע מֵעֲבֹדַתְכֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tem lə·ḵū qə·ḥū lā·ḵem te·ḇen mê·’ă·šer tim·ṣā·’ū kî ’ên niḡ·rā‘ mê·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ·ḵem dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it but your workload will in no way be reduced
verses.literalPt: Ide vós mesmos, e tomai vós palha onde a achardes; porque nada se diminuirá de vosso serviço.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥פֶץ הָעָ֖ם בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ קַ֖שׁ לַתֶּֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·p̄eṣ hā·‘ām bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim lə·qō·šêš qaš lat·te·ḇen
verses.literal: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw
verses.literalPt: Então o povo se espalhou por toda a terra do Egito, a colher restolho em lugar de palha.

verses.original: וְהַנֹּגְשִׂ֖ים אָצִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּלּ֤וּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם֙ דְּבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּהְי֥וֹת הַתֶּֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·ḡə·śîm ’ā·ṣîm lê·mōr kal·lū ma·‘ă·śê·ḵem də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw ka·’ă·šer bih·yō·wṯ hat·te·ḇen
verses.literal: The taskmasters kept pressing them saying Fulfill your quota . . . each day . . . just as you did when straw was provided
verses.literalPt: E os exatores os apertavam, dizendo: Acabai vossa obra, a tarefa de cada dia, como quando havia palha.

verses.original: וַיֻּכּ֗וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣מוּ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם נֹגְשֵׂ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּ֡וּעַ לֹא֩ כִלִּיתֶ֨ם חָקְכֶ֤ם לִלְבֹּן֙ כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם גַּם־ תְּמ֖וֹל גַּם־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yuk·kū šō·ṭə·rê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- śā·mū ‘ă·lê·hem nō·ḡə·śê p̄ar·‘ōh lê·mōr mad·dū·a‘ lō ḵil·lî·ṯem ḥā·qə·ḵem lil·bōn kiṯ·mō·wl šil·šōm gam- tə·mō·wl gam- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then the Israelite . . . foremen whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people were beaten and asked Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today . . . as you did before . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E foram açoitados os oficiais dos filhos de Israel, que os exatores de Faraó tinham posto sobre eles, dizendo estes: Por que não acabastes vossa tarefa, fazendo tijolos como antes, assim também ontem e hoje?

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֧מָּה תַעֲשֶׂ֦ה כֹ֖ה לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū šō·ṭə·rê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yiṣ·‘ă·qū ’el- par·‘ōh lê·mōr lām·māh ṯa·‘ă·śeh ḵōh la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: So the Israelite . . . foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh . . . Why are you treating your servants this way
verses.literalPt: Por isso, os oficiais dos filhos de Israel, foram e clamaram a Faraó, dizendo: Por que fazes assim a teus servos?

verses.original: תֶּ֗בֶן אֵ֤ין נִתָּן֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ וּלְבֵנִ֛ים אֹמְרִ֥ים לָ֖נוּ עֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדֶ֛יךָ מֻכִּ֖ים וְחָטָ֥את עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: te·ḇen ’ên nit·tān la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·lə·ḇê·nîm ’ō·mə·rîm lā·nū ‘ă·śū wə·hin·nêh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā muk·kîm wə·ḥā·ṭāṯ ‘am·me·ḵā
verses.literal: No straw has been given to your servants yet we are told . . . Make bricks Look your servants are being beaten but the fault is with your own people
verses.literalPt: Palha não se dá a teus servos, e nos dizem: Fazei tijolos; e eis que teus servos são açoitados; porém o teu povo tem a culpa.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר נִרְפִּ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם נִרְפִּ֑ים עַל־ כֵּן֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nir·pîm ’at·tem nir·pîm ‘al- kên ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm nê·lə·ḵāh niz·bə·ḥāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are slackers Pharaoh replied Slackers That is why . . . you keep saying Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas ele disse: Vós sois ociosos; vós sois ociosos; por isso dizeis: Vamos, sacrifiquemos ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ לְכ֣וּ עִבְד֔וּ וְתֶ֖בֶן לֹא־ יִנָּתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וְתֹ֥כֶן לְבֵנִ֖ים תִּתֵּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lə·ḵū ‘iḇ·ḏū wə·ṯe·ḇen lō- yin·nā·ṯên lā·ḵem wə·ṯō·ḵen lə·ḇê·nîm tit·tên·nū
verses.literal: Now get to work You will be given no straw yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks
verses.literalPt: Ide, pois, agora, trabalhai; palha porém não se vos dará; contudo, dareis a conta dos tijolos.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֞וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵ֧י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּרָ֣ע לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־ תִגְרְע֥וּ מִלִּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū šō·ṭə·rê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’ō·ṯām bə·rā‘ lê·mōr lō- ṯiḡ·rə·‘ū mil·liḇ·nê·ḵem də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: The Israelite . . . foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told You must not reduce your daily . . . quota of bricks
verses.literalPt: Então os oficiais dos filhos de Israel viram-se em aflição, porquanto se dizia: Nada diminuireis de vossos tijolos, da tarefa do dia no seu dia.

verses.original: וַֽיִּפְגְּעוּ֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן נִצָּבִ֖ים לִקְרָאתָ֑ם בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ת פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·gə·‘ū ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm liq·rā·ṯām bə·ṣê·ṯām mê·’êṯ par·‘ōh
verses.literal: When they left . . . Pharaoh they confronted Moses and Aaron who stood waiting to meet them
verses.literalPt: E encontraram a Moisés e a Arão, que estavam defronte deles, quando saíram de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם יֵ֧רֶא יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְיִשְׁפֹּ֑ט אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ רֵיחֵ֗נוּ בְּעֵינֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ וּבְעֵינֵ֣י עֲבָדָ֔יו לָֽתֶת־ חֶ֥רֶב בְּיָדָ֖ם לְהָרְגֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem yê·re Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·yiš·pōṭ ’ă·šer hiḇ·’aš·tem ’eṯ- rê·ḥê·nū bə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw lā·ṯeṯ- ḥe·reḇ bə·yā·ḏām lə·hā·rə·ḡê·nū
verses.literal: May the LORD . . . look upon you and judge you the foremen said . . . for you have made us a stench - before Pharaoh . . . and his officials you have placed in their hand a sword to kill us
verses.literalPt: E disseram-lhes: O SENHOR atente sobre vós, e julgue isso, porquanto fizestes o nosso caso repelente diante de Faraó, e diante de seus servos, dando-lhes a espada nas mãos, para nos matar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗י לָמָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֙תָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה שְׁלַחְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy lā·māh hă·rê·‘ō·ṯāh lā·‘ām haz·zeh lām·māh zeh šə·laḥ·tā·nî
verses.literal: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked Lord why have You brought trouble upon this people Is this why You sent me
verses.literalPt: Então, tornando-se Moisés ao SENHOR, disse: Senhor! por que fizeste mal a este povo? por que me enviaste?

verses.original: וּמֵאָ֞ז בָּ֤אתִי אֶל־ פַּרְעֹה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ הֵרַ֖ע לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַצֵּ֥ל לֹא־ הִצַּ֖לְתָּ אֶת־ עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·’āz bā·ṯî ’el- par·‘ōh lə·ḏab·bêr biš·me·ḵā hê·ra‘ lā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·haṣ·ṣêl lō- hiṣ·ṣal·tā ’eṯ- ‘am·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in Your name he has brought trouble on this people and You have not delivered Your people in any way
verses.literalPt: Porque desde que me apresentei a Faraó para falar em teu nome, ele maltratou a este povo; e de nenhuma sorte livraste o teu povo.
